description: We are Team AETHER, exploring how Earth's extreme environments can guide future Moon and Mars bases. Using NASA imagery, planetary maps, and Perseverance rover data, we compare geology, temperature, pressure, humidity, and radiation across three worlds. Our interactive portal brings research, maps, and scientific charts together, while our Sparjon rover concept imagines safer exploration. AETHER turns Earth analog research into practical insights for choosing and preparing future human habitats.
